title: Container Report - Week 47
summary:
Container
Container freight rates were mixed over the past week, with the FBX Weighted Average declining 57 points from 3,476 to 3,419. The main Asia-US West Coast trade lane (FBX01) recorded a significant correction, falling $809 from $8,452 to $7,643/FEU by week's end. Similar downward pressure was evident on the Asia-US East Coast route (FBX03), which declined $427 from $9,848 to $9,421/FEU.
